usedFor: Slack carries channel messages, and TURKEY SMS texts a number through your TURKEY SMS account on each one.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Send SMS” in TURKEY SMS
bestTemplate.why: An urgent channel post reaches someone who is away from Slack as a text.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” includes bot messages, so a bot post in that channel also sends a text.
